top_strength: Zhang gathered comprehensive logistics details across all three locations (addresses, floor levels, access, special items, box counts) and delivered a specific, itemized estimate ($2,073 for 5–6 hours, three movers) anchored to the customer's actual move profile.
coaching_note: The two-concerns question must open step 2 before any logistics probing starts — it's the only way to discover what actually matters to this customer, and skipping it means missing the entire opportunity to build trust on their real fears before pitching reliability and damage coverage.
